trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner {name: 'William Chisholm'})-[:Owns]->(t) RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE toLower(trim(o.name)) = 'william chisholm' AND toLower(t.team_name) = 'boston celtics' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
